description.name: DNA Extended
description.tagline: DNA Extended is a WHMCS addon that allows you to manage your DomainNameApi account from within WHMCS.
description.long: DNA Extended is a WHMCS addon that allows you to manage your DomainNameApi account from within WHMCS. It allows you to view, synchronize and import your domain names, and make bulk contact, nameserver, privacy, domain lock and transfer changes.
features: Edit bulk Privacy and Domain Lock
